data_date: current product accessed 2026-10-02; updated every six weeks

field_evidence.uprn_semantics: OS Open UPRN provides a Unique Property Reference Number for every addressable location in Great Britain.
field_evidence.coordinate_semantics: The product provides coordinate references associated with each UPRN so records can be spatially analysed and visualised.
field_evidence.authority: Ordnance Survey states that UPRNs are primarily allocated by Local Authorities under their legal duty to maintain this information.
field_evidence.update_cadence: The product is updated every six weeks.
field_evidence.data_structure: Vector product available as CSV and GeoPackage.
field_evidence.parcel_limitation: The product page describes addressable-location identifiers and coordinates, not cadastral/title parcel polygons.
